source_state: New codex/trim-runtime-libraries branch from merged PR #44; build/test inputs captured before the cleanup commit.
scope: Linux/amd64 native runtime libraries, direct/transitive ELF linkage, indirect NSS/charset loading and isolated Rustls behavior. Other architectures not runtime-tested; non-library trust/resolver/timezone data retained.
decision: Remove complete unused C++/OpenMP/Zstd packages and remaining unused libc ELF/gconv modules. Retain only application + four required native ELF libraries; use pinned libc built-in files/dns NSS, C locale and no application native plugins/extension loading.

package_review.ownership_integrity: Removed file hashes checked against pinned base package manifests. Retained libc6 identity/version remains, and its owned-file manifest is filtered to shipped files. gcc-14-base remains as libgcc-s1 package dependency/licensing.

indirect_loading.nss_assessment: files and dns use module_load_builtin in reviewed libc. No external NSS backend remains configured.

indirect_loading.nsswitch_after:

passwd: files
group: files
shadow: files
gshadow: files
hosts: files dns
networks: files
protocols: files
services: files
ethers: files
rpc: files
netgroup: files
indirect_loading.charset_assessment: LC_ALL=C required; release imports no iconv/gettext/setlocale/uselocale. Rust handles UTF-8; bundled SQLite handles its own encoding and exposes no enabled extension loading. gconv tables/modules are unused.
indirect_loading.limits: dlopen/dlsym remain in bundled SQLite; no claim about arbitrary plugins/locales/NSS configurations. New native dependencies or configuration require review.

policy.proof: Byte-identical to merged master policy except removal of these four matchers; no filter or deadline change.
